lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The counterparty field resolves to a name and nothing else.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Continuity Holdings. No address. No department. No staff record. No floor in any building in any Enclave.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You file the standard query. It comes back accepted, and then it comes back nothing.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Four times I have asked this shell a question it would not answer. All four were tonight.
